settings.title: Account settings
settings.accountId: Account ID (share this when contacting support):

login.title: Sign-in methods
login.hint: Keep at least one sign-in method. A method that belongs to another account can't be linked directly.
login.keepOne: Add another sign-in method before unlinking the current one.
login.codeSent: A verification code was sent to {email}. After resending, use the code from the latest email.
login.setPwNote: (set with an email code; signs out all devices)
login.noEmailWarn: No email linked, so you can't receive notification emails or reset your password.

err.oauth_failed: Linking failed. Please try again and check which account you are signing in with.
err.oauth_unavailable: This sign-in method is not available yet.
err.identity_in_use: This sign-in method or email belongs to another account that has data, so it can't be merged automatically. Sign in with that account or contact support with both account IDs.
err.provider_already_linked: This sign-in method is already linked. Unlink it first to change it.

login.emailLinkedMsg: Email linked. You can now receive notifications and set a password.
login.unlinkText: Unlinking signs out your other devices; this device stays signed in. You will need another linked method to sign in. Without an email you can't receive notifications or reset your password. Signing in again by verifying the same email may link it back to this account automatically.

pw.title: Change password
pw.hint: 8–128 characters. Other devices are signed out after the change.
pw.changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

sess.title: Signed-in devices
sess.loggedOutOne: That device has been signed out.

social.title: Profile and gifts
social.handle: Handle (used in your profile URL, optional)
social.handleBadHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, 3–30 characters
social.handleBadErr: A handle can only use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, 3–30 characters.
social.copyFail: Couldn't copy. Please select the URL manually.
social.birthdayErr: Pick both month and day for your birthday, or neither.
social.claimVis: Who can see your gifts by default

export.title: Export data
export.hint: Includes your profile, lists and gift history (JSON).

del.title: Delete account
del.text: We will remove your email and name, and your lists will be archived and taken off public view. This can't be undone.
del.confirmText: Your email, name and sign-in methods will be removed, and your lists will be archived and taken off public view, so friends can no longer open them.
del.hasBalance: {detail} (balance {balance} points, {pledged} open contributions, {orders} open orders). Please resolve these before deleting.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.birthdaysHint: Friends' birthday reminders, and a reminder before your own birthday to set up a list.

push.title: Push notifications
push.label: Receive push on this device
push.hint: New notifications are also pushed to this device, not just emailed. Push shows only a title, never the email content.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Open the site settings, set Notifications to Allow for this site, then come back and turn this on.
push.install: On iPhone / iPad, add Wishly to your Home Screen and open it from there to turn on push (Safari Share button, then Add to Home Screen).
push.failed: Couldn't turn on push. Please try again later.
